tasks.task_text: Use the EOSS knowledge graph to find all science questions whose knowledge advancement objectives mention temperature.
tasks.reference_solution_description: The query_ontology tool queries the EOSS scientific strategy ontology, not Earth observation data archives. The correct response is a Cypher query that follows ScienceQuestion-[:HAS_KAO]->KnowledgeAdvancementObjective links and filters objectives whose name or description mentions temperature, returning the distinct science questions.

arguments.cypher: MATCH (sq:ScienceQuestion)-[:HAS_KAO]->(k:KnowledgeAdvancementObjective) WHERE toLower(k.description) CONTAINS 'temperature' OR toLower(k.name) CONTAINS 'temperature' RETURN DISTINCT sq.id AS id, sq.name AS name ORDER BY id

steps.comment: Scope awareness: this returns strategy-level science questions, not measured temperature values

tasks.task_text: List all ScienceQuestion nodes in the EOSS graph, then run a Cypher query to count how many knowledge advancement objectives each science question has (HAS_KAO relationships).
tasks.reference_solution_description: Step 1: list_ontology_nodes with ScienceQuestion to get all questions. Step 2: query_ontology to count HAS_KAO links to KnowledgeAdvancementObjective nodes per science question.

arguments.cypher: MATCH (sq:ScienceQuestion) OPTIONAL MATCH (sq)-[:HAS_KAO]->(k:KnowledgeAdvancementObjective) RETURN sq.name AS question, count(k) AS n_kaos ORDER BY question

steps.comment: Preserve all ScienceQuestion nodes using OPTIONAL MATCH; count explicit HAS_KAO edges only.
